recent: Head coach Lindy Ruff said Friday that Zellweger (concussion) has been cleared to play ahead of Saturday's game against the Chicago Blackhawks, Heather Engel of NHL.com reports.
Kuzmenko (personal) has been removed from the non-roster list ahead of Saturday's matchup with Montreal, per the NHL media site.
Foegele (undisclosed) will play in Saturday's Opening Night matchup against the Toronto Maple Leafs, Bruce Garrioch of Postmedia reports.
